uncited: * SH Degree ($L$): The maximum degree of spherical harmonics.
Uses scalar SH coefficients directly without learnable feature vectors.
Simpler but less flexible for view-dependent effects.
* Time Complexity: Depends on the number of SH coefficients and the dimension of the feature vectors.
The multiplication $f_l^m Y_l^m(d)$ is $O(1)$ per coefficient if $f_l^m$ is a vector of fixed size.
